title: NPTE-PTA
description: The physical therapist assistant licensure examination, built on FSBPT's current NPTE-PTA Test Content Outline: 14 body-system and non-system domains, weighted by the exam's own published item-count ranges.

units.title: Musculoskeletal System
units.gate: Given a musculoskeletal treatment session, apply the specific intervention or precaution a PTA carries out under the plan of care -- not a generic 'do the exercises' answer.

objectives.text: Implementing therapeutic exercise and manual therapy per a PT's established plan of care
Recognizing when a patient's response to treatment requires reporting back to the supervising PT
Applying joint-protection and tissue-healing precautions during intervention
Documenting musculoskeletal treatment sessions and progress toward established goals

units.title: Neuromuscular and Nervous Systems
units.gate: Given a neurological patient during a treatment session, apply the specific motor-learning technique or safety precaution it calls for.

objectives.text: Implementing balance, gait, and coordination interventions per an established plan of care
Recognizing neurological changes during a session that require immediate PT or medical notification
Applying appropriate guarding and facilitation techniques for patients with neurological impairments

units.title: Cardiovascular and Pulmonary Systems
units.gate: Given a patient's vital signs during activity, determine whether to continue, modify, or stop the session -- not a generic 'watch the numbers' answer.

objectives.text: Monitoring vital signs and activity tolerance during a treatment session and responding to abnormal findings
Implementing cardiac and pulmonary rehabilitation activities within established parameters
Recognizing signs of cardiopulmonary distress that require stopping treatment and notifying the supervising PT

units.title: Equipment, Devices, and Technologies
units.gate: Given a patient using an assistive device, apply the specific fitting-check or gait-training step it calls for.

objectives.text: Implementing gait training with assistive devices per an established plan of care
Checking assistive-device fit and function during use

units.title: Safety and Protection
units.gate: Given a patient-safety scenario during a session, apply the specific fall-prevention or infection-control step it calls for.

objectives.text: Applying fall-prevention techniques and correct guarding during functional activities
Applying infection-control precautions correctly during patient care

units.title: Integumentary System
units.gate: Given a wound-care task delegated by a PT, apply the specific dressing or precaution it calls for.

objectives.text: Implementing wound-care interventions per an established plan of care
Recognizing signs of wound infection or non-healing that require PT notification

units.title: Metabolic and Endocrine Systems
units.gate: Given a metabolic complication during activity (e.g., hypoglycemia), apply the specific response it calls for.

objectives.text: Recognizing and responding to signs of hypo/hyperglycemia during a treatment session

units.title: Therapeutic Modalities
units.gate: Given a modality ordered by a PT, apply the specific parameters and precautions it calls for -- not a generic 'apply heat or ice' answer.

objectives.text: Applying thermal, electrical, and mechanical modalities per an established plan of care
Recognizing contraindications and precautions for each modality

units.title: System Interactions
units.gate: Given a patient with comorbid conditions, recognize when a change in one system requires modifying the current session.

objectives.text: Recognizing how a comorbidity changes precautions during an intervention already underway

units.title: Lymphatic System
units.gate: Given a lymphedema patient's session, apply the specific compression or positioning precaution it calls for.

objectives.text: Implementing complete decongestive therapy components per an established plan of care

units.title: Professional Responsibilities
units.gate: Given a professional or supervisory scenario, apply the specific scope-of-practice or documentation requirement it calls for.

objectives.text: Applying the PTA's scope of practice and supervision requirements to a scenario
Documenting care appropriately within a PTA's role

units.title: Gastrointestinal System
units.gate: Given a GI-related complaint during a session, determine whether to continue treatment or notify the supervising PT.

objectives.text: Recognizing GI signs/symptoms during a session that require PT notification

units.title: Genitourinary System
units.gate: Given a genitourinary-related complaint during a session, determine whether to continue treatment or notify the supervising PT.

objectives.text: Recognizing genitourinary signs/symptoms during a session that require PT notification

units.title: Research and Evidence-Based Practice
units.gate: Given an outcome measure used in a session, apply it and interpret the result correctly.

objectives.text: Administering standardized outcome measures correctly and reporting results to the supervising PT
